meta.name: business-operations-skills
meta.description: Use when running, diagnosing, or designing internal business operations — process documentation, vendor SLAs, capacity planning, internal comms, SOP/runbook authoring, procurement spend. Triggers on "BizOps review", "where's the bottleneck", "vendor health", "internal SOP", "all-hands deck", "spend categorization", "capacity for Q3", "process mapping". Forks context to route to one of six BizOps sub-skills (process-mapper, vendor-management, capacity-planner, internal-comms, knowledge-ops, procurement-optimizer) and returns a digest. Distinct from business-growth (external sales motion) and c-level-advisor (strategic, not operational).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理内部运营流程并生成文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统化管理和优化公司内部运营流程。
copy.tagline_en: Map internal operations and generate documentation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically manage and optimize internal business operations.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会判断你的提问属于哪类内部运营问题(流程、供应商、人力规划、内部沟通、SOP/手册、采购),分派给对应的子技能,并返回一份不超过 200 字的摘要;数据不足时会先问一个澄清问题。
howto.when: 当用户提出内部运营相关问题,或说出“BizOps review”“where's the bottleneck”“vendor health”等触发词时触发;它不处理外部销售或战略层问题。

say.text: 我们的订单流程哪里最卡?帮我梳理一下。
say.note: 进入流程映射子技能,产出瓶颈分析。

say.text: 这家供应商的 SLA 表现如何?
say.note: 启动供应商管理子技能核对合同指标。

say.text: 写一份故障响应的 runbook。
say.note: 进入知识运营子技能生成 SOP 文档。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude classifies your question into one of six internal-operations areas, routes it to the matching sub-skill, and returns a ≤200-word digest. It asks one clarifying question when the lane is ambiguous.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you raise an internal-operations question or use trigger phrases like "BizOps review", "where's the bottleneck", or "vendor health". It does not handle external sales or strategic-level issues.

say_en.text: Where is the biggest bottleneck in our order process? Walk me through it.
say_en.note: Routes to process-mapper and yields a bottleneck analysis.

say_en.text: How is this vendor performing against their SLA?
say_en.note: Triggers vendor-management to check contract metrics.

say_en.text: Write a runbook for incident response.
say_en.note: Routes to knowledge-ops to generate an SOP.
